**Phase 1 of 7.**

- **Blocked by:** nothing, start today
- **Runs in parallel with:** 7c1382, 0ab02c, 272aea, 1ebc7d

---
A CfnBudget in CDK with an SNS topic to the owner, plus a hard spend cap on the OpenAI project set by hand in the OpenAI console.

This is a permanent control, not scaffolding. It is the only thing that catches a bug in our own code, which no authentication check ever will.

**Done when:** the budget exists in CDK, a test notification arrives, and the OpenAI cap is set.
